title.en: Role of Economic Survey in Industrial Analysis
title.hi: Role of Economic Survey in Industrial Analysis

content.en: The **Economic Survey** serves as the primary document that reviews the state of the **Indian Economy**. Regarding the industrial sector, it evaluates the **Index of Industrial Production (IIP)**, manufacturing output, and the contribution of the industrial sector to the **Gross Value Added (GVA)**. It highlights structural bottlenecks and the efficacy of government initiatives like 'Make in India' or PLI schemes.

content.en: Students often confuse the Economic Survey data with current real-time statistics; remember that the Survey provides a retrospective analysis of the previous fiscal year.
